# opusfile / opusfile_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `opusfile_fuzzer` ([source](source/opusfile_fuzzer.c), unmodified) over opusfile (gitlab.xiph.org/xiph/opusfile at 6dfd29e7).

op_open_memory, then op_read_stereo to EOF touching link/tag/picture accessors, then 32 deterministic pseudo-random op_pcm_seek + op_read_stereo; the samples read after a seek are not compared with the samples at that offset from the linear pass, and totals/tell values are ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against opusfile at commit 6dfd29e7 with 2 patches to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch opusfile` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `opusfile_fuzzer.plain` | 248,472 | `a8ad440b82368685b70a16926038f99f05ca4b0a6905af2a42e5bae3ff31550b` |
| ubsan | `opusfile_fuzzer.ubsan` | 316,504 | `a39afedd41b022d045249bc5c86a033a6823899470cd1d72c6a83856eca433dc` |
| asan | `opusfile_fuzzer.asan` | 990,296 | `577eba9ed3547548d76760e7e1249dbd81bb32df569fe55044ea6a90c205c0e9` |
| asan-ubsan | `opusfile_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 1,060,216 | `a34a8b5cb54d4677efd83dd306660745ef15a056113ac63686258be14cca6291` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
